productTitle: Cross-Border Rechargeable Touch LED Bar/Restaurant Outdoor Atmosphere Lantern
authoredBy: in-chat scene design — CORRECTED: tall slim open-frame lantern cage with SOLID OPAQUE base (no light), plain metal-tube structural edges, and a small recessed inset DOWNLIGHT panel inside the top (about 60% of the top opening) emitting warm downward glow; 18 colour variants dedup to 6 unique cycled 1-6; warm white 2700-3000K

scenes.prompt: An intimate speakeasy bistro two-top, shot on a 35mm lens at seated guest eye-level slight three-quarter so the slim rectangular metal-frame LED lantern anchors the back-centre of a 1:1 frame on a small white-marble bistro table. Early evening dusk: dimly lit room beyond, the only other light source is a distant brass pendant glowing over the bar deep in the blurred background. Style with two espresso cups on saucers, a hand-thrown stoneware plate with biscotti and dark figs, a folded raw-linen napkin tied with twine, and a small ceramic bud vase with a single rosemary sprig; cane-back bistro chair just visible at frame-edge. The lamp matches the reference image exactly — tall slim rectangular open-frame lantern cage in the painted metal body colour shown in the reference (~28cm tall, ~10x10cm base), with a solid OPAQUE square base panel that emits NO light, four plain structural metal-tube vertical edges (NOT light strips) that emit NO light, and ONLY ONE light source — a single small recessed inset square downlight panel mounted INSIDE the top of the lantern frame, occupying ONLY about half (around 50%) of the top opening — that emits a soft warm DOWNWARD beam contained STRICTLY inside the hollow interior of the cage (fading before it reaches the base). NO light spills from the top of the lantern, NO halo or glow surrounds the frame from the outside, NO glow on the vertical metal edges, NO glow at the base — the light is fully contained INSIDE the cage and visible only as a soft downward wash within the hollow interior. Switched ON, warm white 2700-3000K (matches the warm ambient glow shown in the variant reference). Palette of cream plaster, white marble, brushed metal, warm stoneware, sage rosemary. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people, no cinematic moodiness.
accents: stoneware plate of biscotti and figs
